guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：EUV 多層膜反射鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: EUV multilayer mirrors
guides.concept: 從 EUV 強吸收出發，理解 Mo/Si 多層膜為何能反射、週期與粗糙度如何決定反射率，再把面形、鍍膜應力、污染、熱負載與波前誤差預算整合成可驗收的反射鏡工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from strong EUV absorption to see why Mo/Si multilayers reflect, how period and roughness set reflectance, then integrate figure, coating stress, contamination, thermal load and wavefront budgets into an acceptable mirror engineering record.
procedure: 在 13.5 nm 波長，所有固體材料的折射率都非常接近 1 且吸收係數很大，折射率可寫成 n = 1 − δ + iβ，δ 與 β 都只有百分之幾或更小；光在數十奈米內就被吸收，所以不能用透鏡折射成像，整個光路必須放在真空中並以多層膜反射鏡轉折與聚焦。空氣本身也會吸收 EUV，因此照明、光罩與投影光學都在真空腔內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反射式光路與真空腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Mo/Si 多層膜由約 40 到 50 組雙層構成，每組週期 d 約 6.9 nm，Mo 約佔週期的 0.4。各界面的微弱反射在正向入射時因為光程差等於一個波長而同相疊加，形成類似布拉格繞射的反射峰；由於材料吸收，週期數超過約 50 組後反射率不再提升。理論峰值約 74%，實際鍍膜約 70%。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鏡面誤差依空間頻率分成三段：低頻的面形誤差直接變成波前像差；中頻粗糙度（MSFR）把光散射到像點附近形成眩光（flare），降低影像對比；高頻粗糙度（HSFR）把光散射到視場之外，等效降低反射率。因為波長只有 13.5 nm，可接受的粗糙度是 0.1 nm 等級，比可見光光學嚴格兩個數量級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基板面形與粗糙度頻譜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
多層膜通常以磁控濺鍍或離子束濺鍍逐層沉積，並以石英晶體或原位反射率監控厚度；每層厚度誤差必須控制在 0.01 nm 等級。Mo/Si 多層膜通常帶有數百 MPa 的壓應力，會把基板彎曲並改變已拋光好的面形，因此需要應力補償層、退火或在設計階段預留變形量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「濺鍍腔與膜應力」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
EUV 光子與殘留碳氫化合物作用會在鏡面沉積碳；殘留水氣則使最上層 Si 氧化，氧化通常不可逆。因此多層膜頂部加上數奈米的 Ru 覆蓋層抗氧化，並以氫自由基清潔週期性移除碳膜。真空腔的殘氣分壓、材料除氣與光罩附近的清潔策略都屬於鏡面壽命工程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Ru 覆蓋層與氫清潔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

投影光學由多片反射鏡組成，每片面形誤差在反射時加倍計入波前。影像品質以 RMS 波前誤差衡量，Maréchal 判準要求總 RMS 約小於 λ/14 才能維持 Strehl 比 0.8；在 13.5 nm 這相當於約 1 nm。各鏡的面形、鍍膜、對準與熱變形必須以均方根相加分配到次奈米等級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波前誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
每片鏡子吸收約 30% 的 EUV 以及光源帶來的紅外與帶外輻射，鏡面溫度會上升並隨曝光負載變化。基板採用 ULE 或 Zerodur 等超低膨脹玻璃陶瓷，熱膨脹係數在 ±20 ppb/K 以內，再配合主動溫控、熱感測與模型補償，才能把熱致面形漂移壓在次奈米。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱控與低膨脹基板」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
反射鏡以撓性或運動學支撐安裝，避免夾持應力並允許微米到奈米級的位置調整；每片鏡子的位移與傾斜對波前的靈敏度由光學設計的靈敏度矩陣給出。最後以成像或波前系統量測、眩光量測與壽命外推共同構成驗收，而不是只看元件各自合格。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「系統對準與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: At 13.5 nm every solid has a refractive index very close to 1 with strong absorption; writing n = 1 − δ + iβ, both δ and β are a few percent or less, and the light is absorbed within tens of nanometers. Refractive lenses therefore cannot image EUV, so the whole optical train is folded and focused by multilayer mirrors inside a vacuum chamber, because air itself absorbs EUV as well. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A Mo/Si multilayer has about 40 to 50 bilayers with a period d of roughly 6.9 nm and a molybdenum fraction near 0.4. The weak reflections from each interface add in phase at normal incidence because the round-trip path equals one wavelength, giving a Bragg-like reflectance peak; absorption makes additional bilayers beyond about 50 useless. The theoretical peak is about 74% and production coatings reach about 70%. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mo/Si multilayer stack”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Mirror errors are split by spatial frequency: low-frequency figure error becomes wavefront aberration; mid-spatial-frequency roughness (MSFR) scatters light near the image point as flare that reduces contrast; high-spatial-frequency roughness (HSFR) scatters light out of the field and acts like a reflectance loss. Because the wavelength is only 13.5 nm, acceptable roughness is of order 0.1 nm, two orders of magnitude tighter than visible optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Substrate figure and roughness spectrum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Multilayers are deposited layer by layer by magnetron or ion-beam sputtering with quartz-crystal or in-situ reflectance thickness control; per-layer errors must stay near 0.01 nm. Mo/Si stacks typically carry several hundred MPa of compressive stress that bends the substrate and alters the polished figure, so compensation layers, annealing or pre-compensated figure are required. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sputter chamber and coating stress”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

EUV photons react with residual hydrocarbons to deposit carbon on the mirror, while residual water oxidises the top silicon layer, usually irreversibly. A few nanometres of ruthenium capping resists oxidation, and hydrogen-radical cleaning periodically removes carbon films. Residual-gas partial pressures, material outgassing and cleaning strategy near the reticle are all part of mirror-lifetime engineering. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ruthenium capping layer and hydrogen cleaning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Projection optics use several mirrors, and each mirror's figure error enters the wavefront twice on reflection. Image quality is judged by RMS wavefront error; the Maréchal criterion asks for a total RMS below about λ/14 to keep a Strehl ratio of 0.8, which at 13.5 nm is about 1 nm. Figure, coating, alignment and thermal terms of every mirror must be allocated root-sum-square to sub-nanometre values. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Wavefront-error budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each mirror absorbs about 30% of the EUV plus infrared and out-of-band radiation from the source, so its temperature rises and varies with exposure load. Substrates use ultralow-expansion glass ceramics such as ULE or Zerodur with thermal expansion within ±20 ppb/K, combined with active temperature control, thermal sensing and model-based compensation, to keep thermal figure drift sub-nanometre. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thermal control and ultralow-expansion substrate”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Mirrors are held on flexure or kinematic mounts that avoid clamping stress and allow micrometre-to-nanometre adjustment; the wavefront sensitivity to each mirror's displacement and tilt comes from the optical design's sensitivity matrix. Acceptance combines system wavefront or imaging measurement, flare measurement and lifetime extrapolation rather than separate component passes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “System alignment and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把 DUV 的折射式鏡頭觀念套到 EUV，會估出根本不存在的透鏡光路；真實失效是光在元件內被吸收而沒有能量到達晶圓，系統通量不足。
若把 Si 當最外層，水氣氧化使反射率永久下降；若氫清潔過強，會侵蝕或起泡覆蓋層，同樣造成不可逆損失。
pitfallsEn: Carrying DUV refractive-lens thinking into EUV produces a lens train that cannot exist; the real failure is light absorbed inside the element so that throughput at the wafer collapses.
Leaving silicon as the outermost layer lets water oxidation permanently lower reflectance; over-aggressive hydrogen cleaning erodes or blisters the cap, also irreversibly.

related.title: ASML 微影投影光學工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「EUV 強吸收與反射式架構」與「表面污染、氧化與覆蓋層」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；ASML 微影投影光學工程的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture" and "Surface contamination, oxidation and capping layers" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of ASML lithography projection-optics engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦13.5 nm 反射式光學的多層膜、面形、污染與波前預算；ASML 微影投影光學工程則以從 Rayleigh 解析度到折反射浸潤鏡頭的像差、熱漂移與套刻預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on multilayer reflectance, figure, contamination and wavefront budgets for 13.5 nm reflective optics; ASML lithography projection-optics engineering centres on from Rayleigh resolution to aberration, thermal drift and overlay budgets of catadioptric immersion lenses, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「反射式光路與真空腔」與「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到ASML 微影投影光學工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「鏡頭加熱、像差漂移與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber” and “Projection-lens NA and image space”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to ASML lithography projection-optics engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Lens heating, aberration drift and the error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: EUV 多層膜反射鏡
history.text: 1980 年代 Barbee 等人證明 Mo/Si 多層膜可在軟 X 光波段達到高反射率，使 13.5 nm 反射式微影成為可能；ZEISS 與 ASML 合作的 EUV 投影光學於 2010 年代進入量產微影機，近年的 High-NA EUV 更把數值孔徑提升到 0.55，鏡面尺寸與面形要求再提高一級。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何專有膜系配方。
history.textEn: In the 1980s Barbee and colleagues showed that Mo/Si multilayers reach high soft-X-ray reflectance, making reflective lithography at 13.5 nm feasible; EUV projection optics developed by ZEISS with ASML entered production lithography tools in the 2010s, and recent High-NA EUV raised the numerical aperture to 0.55 with larger mirrors and tighter figure. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic, not any proprietary coating recipe.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「EUV 強吸收與反射式架構」到「鏡組整合、對準與驗收」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture" through "Mirror-set integration, alignment and acceptance" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.

references.scopeEn: Explains DUV lenses versus vacuum multilayer mirrors for EUV because of strong absorption, and the flatness requirement; no coating recipe.
